description.paragraph: I am a Venezuelan self-taught web developer, currently living in Brazil. My programming journey began in 2023, driven by curiosity and the desire to build things from scratch. I started with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript focused on Frontend development, but soon discovered Backend with Node.js, which sparked a strong interest in understanding how servers work and exploring tools like Docker.

Although I am not yet working formally in the tech industry, I don't give up. I keep learning in my free time, facing challenges, and creating projects that bring me closer to my goal. I firmly believe that constant learning is key, which is why I like sharing what I know to help others who are also starting out.

slider.title: I have worked with these technologies throughout my learning journey:

descripcion.paragraph: My first application developed with JavaScript, allowing users to search for Pokémon by name or number using an external API.
I thought about modifying it a bit, but I wanted to keep it this way to remember how I started.
A web application made with JavaScript that allows users to search for recipes using an external API. Users can mark them as favorites and view them later.
This is a project from Professor Juan Pablo de la Torre's Udemy course, though I changed a few things to increase the complexity at the time.
A web application to publish, view, and filter posts from registered users. It features authentication, email sending, and more.
I learned to see how apps relate to APIs and databases. I really enjoyed working with these technologies.
An application built with Express that allows users to explore tourist destinations. All information is managed with Sequelize as the ORM.
I really enjoyed finishing this one; at first, I found it complicated and thought about quitting. Node, Express, and databases are things I really like now.
